release.qualification_note: Source-only CPU efficiency release; identical profile, existing graph32 evidence and learner clocks. Linux qualification narrowed parallel submission to multirow batches. H100 gates remain mandatory before migration.

cpu_validation.scope: source/env/CPU/controller validation; H100 required during stopped cutover

native_qualification.refinement: Require at least two response rows per pending session before parallel submission. Single-row leaf updates stay serial.
native_qualification.scope: CPU component comparison while the existing training workload continued; no actor throughput or Elo claim.

initial_pinned.scope: CPU native search with synthetic evaluation; not H100 or Elo throughput

corrected.scope: CPU native search with synthetic evaluation; not H100 or Elo throughput

h100_smoke.execution: eager BF16 interface smoke, not a benchmark

h100_differential.scope: eager frozen-production EMA model, ring10 batch16, 8 finalized + 8 policy-only legal prefixes; FP32/BF16 validated/trusted losses and every parameter gradient; native BF16 cold/cache/graph-replay outputs; no compiler, optimizer, throughput, strength or Elo qualification
h100_differential.acceptance: bitwise tensor equality and exact response lists; no tolerance relaxation

h100_acceptance_scope_note: The differential uses torch.equal (exact numerical tensor equality), not a signed-zero-sensitive byte comparison, despite its raw acceptance label. All reported maximum absolute differences were zero; no tolerance was used.
